attempted_claim: Let G^3_{n,p} be the random 3-graph and C^3_4 the 3-uniform linear 4-cycle. Prove a.a.s. as n->infinity: ex(G^3_{n,p},C^3_4)=(1+o(1))e(G^3_{n,p}) for n^{-3}<<p<<n^{-5/3}; ex(G^3_{n,p},C^3_4)=Theta(n^{4/3+o(1)}) for n^{-5/3}<<p<<n^{-2/3}; ex(G^3_{n,p},C^3_4)=Theta(pn^2) for p>>n^{-2/3}, up to polylogarithmic factors in the upper bounds at the transition points.
decisive_failure: Upper bounds via container transfer are blocked by the star obstruction: every vertex-star is C^3_4-free with Theta(n^2) edges, falsifying balanced supersaturation at m ~ n^{4/3}. The dense-regime repair needs stability machinery beyond this pass. Only routine lower bounds were verified.
